{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ergagesh Ocean''' was a huge mass of water on [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]] that separated the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] two continents, [[Ersheg]] and [[Queesh]]. The [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] was composed of water, salt and other chemical compounds and was not polluted, the [[Ergesh]] taking special care of their environment. The Ergesh used organic airships made up of giant plant spores to cross the Ergagesh Ocean.
